mapper.sql: LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p.difficulty_score, 5), 1), 10) * CASE WHEN p.expected_end_date IS NULL THEN 1.0 WHEN DATEDIFF(p.expected_end_date, p.end_date) >= 2 THEN 1.2 WHEN p.end_date <= p.expected_end_date THEN 1.0 ELSE GREATEST(0.0, 1.0 - DATEDIFF(p.end_date, p.expected_end_date) * 0.1) END * CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0) >= 100 THEN 1.2 WHEN p.achievement_rate >= 90 THEN 1.1 WHEN p.achievement_rate >= 80 THEN 1.0 WHEN p.achievement_rate >= 60 THEN 0.8 ELSE 0 END
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance p INNER JOIN evaluation e ON e.employee_id = p.employee_id AND e.evaluator_id = #{employeeId} WHERE p.status = 'WAITING'

SELECT CONCAT(base.scoreMonth, '월') AS monthLabel, base.score AS score FROM ( SELECT p.employee_id AS employeeId, YEAR(p.end_date) AS scoreYear, MONTH(p.end_date) AS scoreMonth, ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'PERSONAL' THEN ELSE 0 END), 0) * (COALESCE(weight_config.personal_weight_rate, 50) / 100.0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'TEAM' THEN ELSE 0 END), 0) * (COALESCE(weight_config.team_weight_rate, 50) / 100.0) ) * 3 AS score FROM performance p LEFT JOIN performance_weight weight_config ON weight_config.org_id = #{orgId} WHERE p.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL AND p.status = 'ENDED' AND p.end_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY p.employee_id, YEAR(p.end_date), MONTH(p.end_date) ) base ORDER BY base.scoreYear, base.scoreMonth

SELECT p.performance_id AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.feedback, ''), NULLIF(p.comment, ''), '등록된 피드백이 없습니다.') AS text, '시스템' AS author, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at), '%Y.%m.%d') AS date, p.performance_id AS inquiryItemId, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.work_detail, ''), p.title) AS detail FROM performance p WHERE p.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND p.status = 'ENDED' AND (NULLIF(p.feedback, '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(p.comment, '') IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at) DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT p.performance_id AS id, CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'TEAM' THEN 'Team' ELSE 'Individual' END AS type, p.title, LEFT(COALESCE(p.work_detail, ''), 24) AS coreTask, CASE WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(p.start_date, '%Y.%m.%d'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(p.end_date, '%Y.%m.%d')) WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(p.start_date, '%Y.%m.%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y.%m.%d') END AS date, CASE WHEN p.status = 'ENDED' THEN '완료' WHEN p.status = 'WAITING' THEN '대기' ELSE '진행중' END AS status, COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0) AS progress, p.employee_id AS employeeId, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.work_detail, ''), p.title) AS description, COALESCE(NULLIF(pt.team_result_summary, ''), NULLIF(pp.result_summary, ''), NULLIF(p.comment, ''), '-') AS achievement FROM performance p LEFT JOIN performance_personal pp ON pp.performance_id = p.performance_id LEFT JOIN performance_team pt ON pt.performance_id = p.performance_id WHERE ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.performance_id AS id, CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'TEAM' THEN 'Team' ELSE 'Individual' END AS type, p.title, LEFT(COALESCE(p.work_detail, ''), 24) AS coreTask, CASE WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(p.start_date, '%Y.%m.%d'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(p.end_date, '%Y.%m.%d')) WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(p.start_date, '%Y.%m.%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y.%m.%d') END AS date, CASE WHEN p.status = 'ENDED' THEN '완료' WHEN p.status = 'WAITING' THEN '대기' ELSE '진행중' END AS status, COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0) AS progress, p.employee_id AS employeeId, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.work_detail, ''), p.title) AS description, COALESCE(NULLIF(pt.team_result_summary, ''), NULLIF(pp.result_summary, ''), NULLIF(p.comment, ''), '-') AS achievement FROM performance p LEFT JOIN performance_personal pp ON pp.performance_id = p.performance_id LEFT JOIN performance_team pt ON pt.performance_id = p.performance_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND p.employee_id IN
#{employeeId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT base.scoreYear AS scoreYear, base.scoreMonth AS scoreMonth, base.score AS score FROM ( SELECT p.employee_id AS employeeId, YEAR(p.end_date) AS scoreYear, MONTH(p.end_date) AS scoreMonth, ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'PERSONAL' THEN ELSE 0 END), 0) * (COALESCE(weight_config.personal_weight_rate, 50) / 100.0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'TEAM' THEN ELSE 0 END), 0) * (COALESCE(weight_config.team_weight_rate, 50) / 100.0) ) * 3 AS score FROM performance p LEFT JOIN performance_weight weight_config ON weight_config.org_id = #{orgId} WHERE AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL AND p.status = 'ENDED' AND DATE(p.end_date) >= #{windowStart} AND DATE(p.end_date) < #{windowEndExclusive} GROUP BY p.employee_id, YEAR(p.end_date), MONTH(p.end_date) ) base ORDER BY base.scoreYear, base.scoreMonth

SELECT base.scoreYear AS scoreYear, base.scoreMonth AS scoreMonth, ROUND(AVG(base.score)) AS score FROM ( SELECT p.employee_id AS employeeId, YEAR(p.end_date) AS scoreYear, MONTH(p.end_date) AS scoreMonth, ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'PERSONAL' THEN ELSE 0 END), 0) * (COALESCE(weight_config.personal_weight_rate, 50) / 100.0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'TEAM' THEN ELSE 0 END), 0) * (COALESCE(weight_config.team_weight_rate, 50) / 100.0) ) * 3 AS score FROM performance p LEFT JOIN performance_weight weight_config ON weight_config.org_id = #{orgId} WHERE 1 = 1
AND p.employee_id IN
#{employeeId}
AND 1 = 0
AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL AND p.status = 'ENDED' AND DATE(p.end_date) >= #{windowStart} AND DATE(p.end_date) < #{windowEndExclusive} GROUP BY p.employee_id, YEAR(p.end_date), MONTH(p.end_date) ) base GROUP BY base.scoreYear, base.scoreMonth ORDER BY base.scoreYear, base.scoreMonth

SELECT p.performance_id AS id, CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'TEAM' THEN 'team' ELSE 'individual' END AS type, p.title, CASE WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(p.start_date, '%m.%d'), ' ~ ', DATE_FORMAT(p.end_date, '%m.%d')) WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(p.start_date, '%m.%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%m.%d') END AS date, COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0) AS progress, CASE WHEN p.status = 'ENDED' THEN ELSE COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0) END AS score, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.work_detail, ''), p.title) AS description, COALESCE(NULLIF(pt.team_result_summary, ''), NULLIF(pp.result_summary, ''), NULLIF(p.comment, ''), '-') AS achievement, NULLIF(COALESCE(p.feedback, p.comment), '') AS feedbackText, '시스템' AS feedbackAuthor, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at), '%Y.%m.%d') AS feedbackDate FROM performance p LEFT JOIN performance_personal pp ON pp.performance_id = p.performance_id LEFT JOIN performance_team pt ON pt.performance_id = p.performance_id WHERE AND YEAR(COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at)) = #{targetYear} AND MONTH(COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at)) = #{targetMonth} ORDER BY COALESCE(p.end_date, p.created_at) DESC

SELECT p.performance_id AS id, p.employee_id AS targetEmployeeId, p.title, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y.%m.%d') AS date, '대기' AS status, CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'TEAM' THEN '팀 성과' ELSE '개인 성과' END AS type, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0) > 0 THEN CONCAT(p.achievement_rate, '%') ELSE NULL END AS achievement, COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0) AS progress, CASE WHEN p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'result' ELSE 'plan' END AS phase FROM performance p LEFT JOIN performance_personal pp ON pp.performance_id = p.performance_id LEFT JOIN performance_team pt ON pt.performance_id = p.performance_id INNER JOIN evaluation ev ON ev.employee_id = p.employee_id AND ev.evaluator_id = #{employeeId} WHERE p.status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE performance SET achievement_rate = COALESCE(#{progress}, achievement_rate), end_date = COALESCE(end_date, CURDATE()), status = 'WAITING', comment = COALESCE(#{comment}, comment) WHERE performance_id = #{performanceId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE performance_personal SET result_summary = COALESCE(#{resultSummary}, result_summary), growth_point = COALESCE(#{growthPoint}, growth_point), improvement = COALESCE(#{improvementPoint}, improvement) WHERE performance_id = #{performanceId}
UPDATE performance_team SET team_result_summary = COALESCE(#{resultSummary}, team_result_summary), special_point = COALESCE(#{resultNote}, special_point) WHERE performance_id = #{performanceId}
mapper.select:
SELECT p.performance_id AS id, p.employee_id AS targetEmployeeId, p.title, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y.%m.%d') AS date, '대기' AS status, CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'TEAM' THEN '팀 성과' ELSE '개인 성과' END AS type, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0) > 0 THEN CONCAT(p.achievement_rate, '%') ELSE NULL END AS achievement, COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0) AS progress, CASE WHEN p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'result' ELSE 'plan' END AS phase FROM performance p WHERE p.status = 'WAITING'
AND p.employee_id IN
#{memberId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE performance p SET p.status = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM performance_personal pp WHERE pp.performance_id = p.performance_id AND NULLIF(pp.result_summary, '') IS NOT NULL ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM performance_team pt WHERE pt.performance_id = p.performance_id AND NULLIF(pt.team_result_summary, '') IS NOT NULL ) THEN 'ENDED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END, p.end_date = CASE WHEN p.end_date IS NULL AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM performance_personal pp WHERE pp.performance_id = p.performance_id AND NULLIF(pp.result_summary, '') IS NOT NULL ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM performance_team pt WHERE pt.performance_id = p.performance_id AND NULLIF(pt.team_result_summary, '') IS NOT NULL )) THEN CURDATE() ELSE p.end_date END, p.feedback = COALESCE(#{comment}, p.feedback) WHERE p.performance_id = #{performanceId} AND p.status = 'WAITING'
UPDATE performance SET status = 'ACTIVE', feedback = COALESCE(#{comment}, feedback) WHERE performance_id = #{performanceId} AND status = 'WAITING'
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT employee_id FROM evaluation WHERE evaluator_id = #{viewerEmployeeId} ORDER BY employee_id

SELECT base.employee_id AS employeeId, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_evaluation te_done WHERE te_done.evaluator_id = #{evaluatorId} AND te_done.appraisee_id = base.employee_id AND te_done.performance_year = YEAR(CURDATE()) ) THEN '완료' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM performance p_wait WHERE p_wait.employee_id = base.employee_id AND p_wait.status = 'WAITING' ) THEN '진행 중' ELSE '평가 대기' END AS status, ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'PERSONAL' AND p.status = 'ENDED' AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN ELSE 0 END), 0) * (COALESCE(MAX(pw.personal_weight_rate), 50) / 100.0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'TEAM' AND p.status = 'ENDED' AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN ELSE 0 END), 0) * (COALESCE(MAX(pw.team_weight_rate), 50) / 100.0) ) * 3 AS systemScore, ROUND(AVG((COALESCE(pr.communication_score, 0) + COALESCE(pr.solving_score, 0) + COALESCE(pr.responsibility_score, 0) + COALESCE(pr.team_contribution, 0)) / 4), 1) AS peerReviewScore, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.communication_score, 0)), 1) AS performanceAvg, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.responsibility_score, 0)), 1) AS attitudeAvg, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.team_contribution, 0)), 1) AS collaborationAvg, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.solving_score, 0)), 1) AS creativityAvg FROM (
) base LEFT JOIN performance p ON p.employee_id = base.employee_id LEFT JOIN performance_weight pw ON pw.org_id = #{orgId} LEFT JOIN evaluation ev ON ev.employee_id = base.employee_id AND ev.confirmed_at IS NULL AND ev.performance_year = YEAR(CURDATE()) LEFT JOIN peer_review pr ON pr.eval_id = ev.eval_id GROUP BY base.employee_id ORDER BY base.employee_id

SELECT base.employee_id AS employeeId, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM peer_review pr WHERE pr.reviewer_id = #{employeeId} AND pr.eval_id IN ( SELECT ev.eval_id FROM evaluation ev WHERE ev.employee_id = base.employee_id AND ev.confirmed_at IS NULL AND ev.performance_year = YEAR(CURDATE()) ) ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS evaluated FROM (
) base ORDER BY base.employee_id
SELECT ev.eval_id FROM evaluation ev WHERE ev.employee_id = #{appraiseeId} AND ev.confirmed_at IS NULL ORDER BY ev.performance_year DESC, ev.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT base.employee_id AS employeeId, ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'PERSONAL' AND p.status = 'ENDED' AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN ELSE 0 END), 0) * (COALESCE(MAX(pw.personal_weight_rate), 50) / 100.0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'TEAM' AND p.status = 'ENDED' AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN ELSE 0 END), 0) * (COALESCE(MAX(pw.team_weight_rate), 50) / 100.0) ) * 3 AS systemScore, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.communication_score, 0)), 1) AS performanceAvg, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.responsibility_score, 0)), 1) AS attitudeAvg, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.team_contribution, 0)), 1) AS collaborationAvg, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pr.solving_score, 0)), 1) AS creativityAvg FROM (
) base LEFT JOIN performance p ON p.employee_id = base.employee_id LEFT JOIN performance_weight pw ON pw.org_id = #{orgId} LEFT JOIN evaluation ev ON ev.employee_id = base.employee_id AND ev.confirmed_at IS NULL AND ev.performance_year = YEAR(CURDATE()) LEFT JOIN peer_review pr ON pr.eval_id = ev.eval_id GROUP BY base.employee_id ORDER BY base.employee_id

SELECT o.org_id AS orgId, o.org_name AS name, COUNT(e.employee_id) AS memberCount FROM organization o LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info h ON h.org_id = o.org_id LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = h.employee_id AND e.employ_state = 'WORK' WHERE o.org_type = 'TEAM' AND o.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY o.org_id, o.org_name ORDER BY o.sort_order, o.org_name

SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_name AS name, p.position_name AS position, (SELECT ev.evaluation_score FROM evaluation ev WHERE ev.employee_id = e.employee_id AND ev.performance_year = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND ev.evaluation_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ev.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS finalScore FROM employee_hr_info h INNER JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = h.employee_id AND e.employ_state = 'WORK' LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.position_id = h.position_id WHERE h.org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY e.employee_name

SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG((te.performance_score + te.attitude_score + te.collaboration_score + te.creativity_score) / 4.0), 1) FROM team_evaluation te WHERE te.appraisee_id = #{employeeId} AND te.performance_year = YEAR(CURDATE())) AS teamEvalScore, (SELECT ROUND(AVG((pr.communication_score + pr.solving_score + pr.responsibility_score + pr.team_contribution) / 4.0), 1) FROM peer_review pr INNER JOIN evaluation ev ON ev.eval_id = pr.eval_id WHERE ev.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ev.performance_year = YEAR(CURDATE())) AS peerReviewScore, (SELECT ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'PERSONAL' AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN ELSE 0 END), 0) * (COALESCE((SELECT pw.personal_weight_rate FROM performance_weight pw WHERE pw.org_id = #{orgId} LIMIT 1), 50) / 100.0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.work_item = 'TEAM' AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN ELSE 0 END), 0) * (COALESCE((SELECT pw.team_weight_rate FROM performance_weight pw WHERE pw.org_id = #{orgId} LIMIT 1), 50) / 100.0) ) * 3 FROM performance p WHERE p.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND p.status = 'ENDED') AS systemScore, (SELECT ev.evaluation_score FROM evaluation ev WHERE ev.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ev.performance_year = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND ev.evaluation_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ev.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS finalScore
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation (employee_id, evaluator_id, performance_year, evaluation_score, confirmed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{evaluatorId}, #{year}, #{score}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE evaluation_score = #{score}, confirmed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()

SELECT p.employee_id AS employeeId, p.performance_id AS performanceId, p.title, CASE WHEN p.status = 'ENDED' THEN 'completed' ELSE 'in_progress' END AS status, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM performance p WHERE 1 = 1
AND p.employee_id IN
#{employeeId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY p.employee_id, p.created_at DESC
